name: sun-sea-o
title: Module-Based Agreement Builder
description: Agreements assembled from individual text modules, each independently authored, negotiated, and signed. The full agreement emerges over time.
audience: Freelancers and clients, business partners, co-founders, or anyone who needs to negotiate and sign an agreement piece by piece instead of all at once.
useCases: A freelancer and client agree on scope but not payment terms yet — they sign the scope module now and negotiate payment separately, without blocking the project
Two co-founders draft a shareholders’ agreement — they work through each clause as a separate module, countering and revising until both sides are satisfied
A supplier and buyer negotiate a service contract — one party proposes updated delivery terms, the other counters, and both can see the full version history
A consultant needs proof of what was agreed — downloads a PDF with SHA-256 verification codes and a timestamped signature log

dataPrivacy.storage: All data stored in Supabase cloud database with row-level security.
dataPrivacy.authentication: Google OAuth via Supabase Auth. Each user only sees their own projects and agreements.
dataPrivacy.signatures: Signing actions recorded with IP, user agent, and timestamp for audit trail.
dataPrivacy.realtime: Live updates via Supabase realtime subscriptions between both parties.
